about: I'm a Full Stack Developer with a versatile skill set. I craft engaging interfaces using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js), as well as foundational HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. My back-end expertise extends to Java and PHP, allowing me to build and maintain a wide variety of scalable, server-side solutions. I enjoy tackling the full scope of a project, from the database to the UI.

list.title: Working Student
list.description: In my role as a Working Student Full Stack Developer, I supported the development team across the entire stack. I handled front-end tasks using HTML, CSS, and React, and contributed to back-end development and maintenance using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, Node.js), as well as Java and PHP.

list.title: Full Stack Developer: Remote
list.description: As a Remote Full Stack Developer, I built and maintained features across the entire stack. I used React, HTML, and CSS for the front-end, and the MERN stack, Java, and PHP for back-end systems and APIs.

list.title: Software Engineer Intern
list.description: In my role as a Software Engineer Intern, I supported development using Java and Python. My responsibilities included working with the Rasa framework to develop and maintain conversational AI solutions.

list.title: MSc. in Software Engineering
list.description: Pursuing a Master's degree in Software Engineering, focusing on advanced software development methodologies, system design, and project management to enhance my skills as a full stack developer.

list.title: Bsc. in Management and Information Technology
list.description: Completed a Bachelor's degree in Management and Information Technology with First Class Honours (3.84/4.00 GPA). This provided me a strong foundation in both business principles and IT, preparing me for a career in software development.

list.title: Project One
list.description: A responsive e-commerce website built with modern front-end technologies to provide a seamless shopping experience.

list.title: Project Two
list.description: An interactive data visualization dashboard that displays real-time analytics using D3.js and a custom API.

list.title: Project Three
list.description: A sleek and modern landing page for a startup, focusing on performance and clean UI/UX design.
